delegatecall_context.meaning: injectSweepAndCall executes in a delegatecall context where address(this) resolves to the user's wallet/shim

delegatecall_guard_present.meaning: injectSweepAndCall is restricted to delegatecall-only execution (onlyDelegatecall or equivalent guard present)

user_funds_sent_to_router.meaning: a user has sent funds to the router expecting stateless routing behavior

router_holds_funds.meaning: the router contract holds accumulated user token/ETH balances available to be drained

attacker_drained_router_funds.meaning: attacker has drained the accumulated router balances via the missing delegatecall guard

assumptions: injectSweepAndCall is callable by an arbitrary external caller (permissionlessness inferred from the missing guard).
Router-held balances exist from prior direct calls or user deposits before the attack.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether a direct call was actually observed; the drain scenario is conditional on a direct call occurring.
Drain impact depends on a separate previously reported missing-guard bug and pre-existing router balances; the exact drain mechanism/amount is not defined in this report.

limitations: Drain is represented as a grounded Boolean occurrence because the report gives no numeric amount or per-call accounting for the drain.
The condition narrows to the direct-call scenario the report establishes; the general delegatecall-only requirement is captured by the intent but the concrete drain is only asserted for direct calls.
